Relevant Quotes: Section 6.6 (Password Management Standard); Exhibit B (Security Metrics Pack); Section 12.1 (Logging); Section 13.3 (Location Controls)
Rationale: The contract explicitly requires a written password standard (Section 6.6), and Vendor must enforce it. The Password Management Standard section explicitly states the requirements for password length and strength, secure storage using salted hashing, and rotation, which demonstrates strong commitment. Furthermore, Vendor's quarterly security metrics pack (Exhibit B) shows 100% MFA coverage and 100% password vault usage for privileged credentials, reinforcing the requirement. Additionally, Vendor is obligated to log and retain security-relevant logs (Section 12.1) and enforce location controls (Section 13.3) to ensure Company Data is stored and processed in the United States only.

Relevant Quotes: Section 9.1–9.2 (Asset Inventory; Inventory Review); Exhibit G (ASSET-01); Exhibit E (Asset Inventory Minimum Fields)
Rationale: The contract explicitly requires the vendor to maintain an in-scope asset inventory (Section 9.1) and review it at least quarterly (Section 9.2). The evidence provided in Exhibit G (ASSET-01) and Exhibit E (Asset Inventory Minimum Fields) demonstrates that all required fields are covered and the inventory review frequency meets the requirement. The vendor also maintains secure configuration baselines for in-scope systems (Section 9.3), which adds to the confidence in the compliance state.

Relevant Quotes: Exhibit G, Security Schedule, G4.4 (Key Rotation); Section 5.2 (No Material Degradation); Exhibit G5 (VULN-04 (Remediation SLAs)); Exhibit G3 (IAM-01 (MFA for privileged access))
Rationale: The contract requires annual security awareness training for all personnel accessing Company Data (Exhibit G, Security Schedule, G4.4, Key Rotation) and enforces MFA for privileged access (Exhibit G, Security Schedule, G3, IAM-01). However, background checks are only mentioned for Vendor Personnel with access (Exhibit G, Security Schedule, G5, SUP-01), and the contract contradicts the requirement regarding full compliance (Section 5.2, No Material Degradation).

Relevant Quotes: Section 5.1 (No Material Degradation of safeguards); Section 18 (Vendor will inform Company of requests for Company Data); Section 10 (Secure Development and Change Management); Exhibit G (Security Schedule, unclear details concerning transmission security)
Rationale: The contract requires the vendor to implement safeguards for confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Company Data, but it does not explicitly mention TLS 1.2 or higher for all data in transit over untrusted networks. Although some provisions address secure development and change management, and notification for Company Data requests, transmission security and encryption standards are unclear, resulting in partial compliance.
